title: Worth a Nickel
description: A simple mod that adds 2 new minerals, nickel and nether nickel
body:
**Worth a Nickel**

![About](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/395156ca9dbd5c3e5534d66148bc1013d11bbd37.png)

Shiny is a simple mod that aims to amplify tool creation trough a new mineral, Nickel! Nickel can be used to craft all sets of nickel blocks (pillar stairs brick etc..) Nickel coins and the new workstation: the Forging table, that workstation will unlock the new villager, the Toolshaper. his trades replace emeralds with nickel coins, and ONLY trough him you can get all 4 tool molds (axe, sword, pickaxe, shovel and hoe) that you can create all sets of tool only using 1 unit of the material!

You can also find nether nickel that can be used to create the all new sets of tools and armors!

![Added content](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/efb0a40dfa076810ee314394897964f3b7b02767.png)
